messages:
elaine: Quick sync on gated launch URL ops — we need a crisp checklist for keywords -> LP mapping, JSON-LD (WebinarEvent + FAQ), canonical rules, internal linking, redirects for promo shortlinks, and lead routing to SFDC. Who can take each?

priya: Ill own the checklist and tracking. Primary keywords: 'low-latency LLM inference' & 'inference cost optimization'. Map to webinar LP, gated ebook LP, and product brief.

marco: Ill do keywords + structured data. Plan: WebinarEvent JSON-LD + FAQPage JSON-LD on LP, breadcrumbList, and canonical tag. Will add snippets to the prelaunch doc and run rich results test.

jun: Content ops: finishing copy. Ill add internal links from docs/runtime, docs/batching, and resources/benchmarks with natural anchor text. Will set blog canonical to LP where appropriate.

dalia: Redirects/infra: prefer 301s for promo shortlinks to preserve equity. Temporary A/B pages use 302. Example edge rule: `location /promo/llm { return 301 /product/inference-webinar?utm=promo; }` Also set staging previews to noindex and schedule CDN purge at launch.

elaine: Lead payload requirements: POST to /px/webhook with email, utm_source, utm_campaign, keyword_bucket, landing_id, variant_id, gdpr_opt_in. Jun, confirm shape and provide Postman.

jun: Confirmed. Sample payload in doc and test harness returning 200 + lead_id. Will include variant_id so we can attribute A/B.

priya: A/B plan: headline A: 'Real-time LLM inference at predictable cost' vs B: 'Production-grade latency for LLMs'. Use Optimizely, capture `variant_id` in webhook, run 7 days and review MQLs.

marco: Also add new LPs to sitemap and request index after launch. Run structured data validator and fix errors before pushing.

elaine: Action recap: Marco  schema + sitemap. Priya  checklist + A/B tracking. Jun  payload + Postman. Dalia  redirects + CDN purge + feature flag. Everyone  final checks in prelaunch doc by 08:30 PT tomorrow. /remind #marketing in 18h to review. :rocket:
